title: What a person entered is still there after a reload
note: Data is saved as it changes and restored on load; a refresh never loses work.
intent: Losing what you entered is the failure people remember. Save to localStorage or IndexedDB as the data changes (not only on a Save button), restore it on load before the first render, version the stored shape so an old save does not crash a new build, and handle a corrupt or missing save by starting empty and saying so. Seed fixtures only when storage is empty, and keep them local (no network). Declare a demo named `reload-keeps-data` that adds an item, rebuilds the store from storage exactly as a page load would, and returns how many items there were before and after.

check.name: reload-keeps-data
check.note: The demo `reload-keeps-data` adds an item and rebuilds the store from storage: result.after equals result.before and is above zero.

port: One store module owns persistence: `store.save()` after each mutation and `store.load()` at boot; components never touch storage.
